review_goal: Validate requests and manage database connections while preserving pool availability on every return path.

directions.prompt: Trace errors, timeouts, retries, cancellation, concurrency, and resource lifecycle across the changed path.

findings.title: Register cleanup before rejecting invalid requests
findings.body: When `valid` is false, this return occurs before `connection.Close()` is deferred, so every invalid request permanently increments `pool.inUse`. After `capacity` invalid requests, subsequent calls fail with `ErrExhausted`—including the third iteration in `main`; register the defer immediately after a successful `Open()`.
